title: Simon Agent Run & Trace Schema
description: Data model for tracking every Managed Agent execution, parent run_id correlation, Gemini interaction_id, and step-by-step trace spans in Firestore/SQLite.

agent_run_id.description: Unique ID for this single Managed Agent execution (e.g. arun_a1b2c3d4e5).

run_id.description: Parent orchestration or pipeline run ID grouping all agent runs in one workflow (e.g. run_a1b2c3d4e5).

parent_agent_run_id.description: Optional upstream agent_run_id when chained across stages (e.g. Stage 1 Discovery -> Stage 2 Investigator).

interaction_id.description: Gemini /v1beta/interactions/{id} identifier for correlating remote sandbox execution.

target.description: Target artist, search lane, or assignment label.

input.description: Opaque assignment or prompt payload sent to the Managed Agent.

output.description: Structured JSON or text output returned by the Managed Agent.
